UK: The power of Mega Evolution is expanding in Pokémon GO!
Get ready to bring your Mega- Evolved Pokémon into all levels of the GO Battle League and take advantage of a special third Charged Attack exclusive to Mega-Evolved Pokémon. You’ll be able to start battling with these Mega-Evolved Pokémon in all levels of the GO Battle League once GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale begins. The event also teases the return of Armored Mewtwo, so you won’t want to miss it.
